reason: The self-hosted Apache-2.0 version on my spare Mac mini is exactly what I would try, so I have no reason to pay $99 for Cloud. And pre-alpha from one developer means I trial it on a side repo before it touches team quota.
objection: Pre-alpha and one maintainer. If the loop guard or budget cap has a bug, it burns our agent quota overnight, and nobody can fix it fast if he gets bored or busy.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of stable releases plus a second maintainer, and proof that the budget stop really fires. Even then I would self-host, not buy Cloud.
